instagram_caption:
A $5,000 credit card balance, paid off at $100 a month, could cost about $9,000 in interest.

At 22.15%, the Federal Reserve's average US bank card rate for accounts charged interest (Q2 2026, G.19 released October 7, 2026), $100 a month takes 141 months, almost 12 years, and about $9,012 in interest. $200 a month clears it in 34 months with about $1,768 in interest: about $7,244 less for the same debt. Assumes no new charges and interest charged monthly at APR/12; real card terms vary.

Did you know your card's APR before reading this?
